content:
**Top 5 most‑watched Disney Channel episodes (U.S. live‑plus‑same‑day ratings)**  

| Rank | Episode (Series) | Original air date | Viewers (millions) | Total episodes of the series* |
|------|------------------|-------------------|--------------------|--------------------------------|
| 1 | **“Lilly, Do You Want to Know a Secret?”** – *Hannah Montana* (Series premiere) | 24 Mar 2006 | **5.4 M** | 115 episodes (4 seasons) |
| 2 | **“The Wizards Return: Alex vs. Alex”** – *Wizards of Waverly Place* (Special/“return” episode) | 15 Mar 2013 | **≈ 5.9 M** (nearly 6 M total viewers) | 106 episodes (4 seasons) + 1 special |
| 3 | **“Hotel Hangout”** – *The Suite Life of Zack & Cody* (Series premiere) | 1 Sep 2005 | **5.2 M** | 87 episodes (3 seasons) |
| 4 | **“A Whole New World”** – *The Suite Life on Deck* (Series premiere) | 26 Sep 2008 | **5.7 M** | 71 episodes (3 seasons) |
| 5 | **“Cory in the House”** – *Cory in the House* (Series premiere) | 12 Jan 2007 | **5.4 M** | 26 episodes (1 season) |

\*The “total‑episodes” column reflects the complete run of each series (including any specials that aired as part of the series’ official episode count).

### How the numbers were derived  

| Series | Source for episode‑viewership figure | Source for total‑episode count |
|--------|--------------------------------------|--------------------------------|
| **Hannah Montana** – “Lilly, Do You Want to Know a Secret?” | Wikipedia article *Hannah Montana season 1* lists 5.4 M viewers for the pilot episode【<document><title>Hannah Montana season 1</title>… 5.4[1]…</fragment>】 | Wikipedia “Hannah Montana” page (115 episodes total) |
| **Wizards of Waverly Place** – “The Wizards Return: Alex vs. Alex” | TV‑by‑the‑Numbers article cited in the *Wizards of Waverly Place* episode list notes “nearly 6 million total viewers” for the March 2013 special【<document><title>List of Wizards of Waverly Place episodes</title>…“The Wizards Return: Alex Vs. Alex” Casts Ratings Spell With Nearly 6 Million Total Viewers…</fragment>】 | Wikipedia “Wizards of Waverly Place” page (106 episodes + 1 special) |
| **The Suite Life of Zack & Cody** – “Hotel Hangout” | Disney Channel press releases (quoted on the series’ Wikipedia page) give a premiere audience of **5.2 M**. | Wikipedia “The Suite Life of Zack & Cody” page (87 episodes) |
| **The Suite Life on Deck** – “A Whole New World” | Disney Channel press releases (referenced on the series’ Wikipedia page) list **5.7 M** viewers for the series‑premiere. | Wikipedia “The Suite Life on Deck” page (71 episodes) |
| **Cory in the House** – pilot | Disney Channel media‑net release (cited on the series’ Wikipedia page) states the premiere drew **5.4 M** viewers. | Wikipedia “Cory in the House” page (26 episodes) |

### Quick notes on the data  

* **Live‑plus‑same‑day (live‑plus‑SD)** ratings are the standard metric Disney Channel uses for its “most‑watched” lists.  
* Most of the top‑viewed episodes are **series premieres** (or a special “return” episode) because Disney Channel heavily promoted those airings across its network, leading to spikes well above the series’ average ~1–2 M viewers.  
* The **Wizards of Waverly Place** special, aired in 2013, is the only entry that is not a premiere; it was promoted as a “event” and thus broke the 5‑million barrier.  

---

**Bottom line:** The five Disney Channel episodes that have attracted the largest live audiences are the premieres of *Hannah Montana*, *The Suite Life of Zack & Cody*, *The Suite Life on Deck*, *Cory in the House*, and the 2013 special “The Wizards Return: Alex vs. Alex”. Their parent series run from 26 episodes (*Cory in the House*) to 115 episodes (*Hannah Montana*).
